Welcome to The Adjusted Perspective – a podcast by chiropractic students, for chiropractic students, future students, and anyone curious about the power of chiropractic care.

Hosted by CJ Peechatka, Carson Tuttle, Joe Crosson, Gabe Higgins, and Eddie Diaz, this podcast dives into the world of chiropractic from the lens of current students passionate about health, healing, and hands-on care. We bring you real conversations about spinal adjustments, chiropractic philosophy, research, anatomy, technique, and the evolving role of chiropractic in today’s healthcare landscape.

Whether you’re deep into your chiropractic education, considering the profession, or just want to learn more about what we do and why it matters — you’re in the right place.

Subscribe for honest insights, engaging discussions, and a student-driven perspective that keeps it real, relevant, and rooted in the purpose of chiropractic.
